name: FlareSolverr
description: Proxy server to bypass Cloudflare and DDoS-GUARD protection

ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Secret path token to protect your FlareSolverr deployment (e.g. access FlareSolverr at https://yourapp.herokuapp.com/<ACCESS_TOKEN>/)

MAX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum timeout in milliseconds for challenge solving requests (defaults to 25000 to fit Heroku's 30s router timeout)

DISABLE_MEDIA.description: Disable loading media (images, fonts, CSS) to save bandwidth and memory
